iris.label: Iris flowers

decision_tree.label: Decision tree
decision_tree.why_choose: It makes step-by-step rules that are beginner-friendly to inspect.
decision_tree.metric_hint: A simple baseline that is easy to explain.

random_forest.label: Random forest
random_forest.why_choose: It reduces the noise of a single tree by combining many small trees.
random_forest.metric_hint: Often stronger because it averages many trees.

nearest_neighbor.label: Nearest neighbor
nearest_neighbor.why_choose: It predicts by looking at the most similar training examples.
nearest_neighbor.metric_hint: Useful when similar records tend to share the same label.

iris.why_chosen: Iris is compact, well balanced, and ideal for a clear species-classification example.
iris.result_summary: The iris flowers nearest neighbor predicts species with 94.7% accuracy on held-out data.
limitations: These are small prepared teaching models, not production systems.
Different models can disagree, especially near class boundaries.
Confidence should be read as model confidence, not ground truth.
